watchlist.name: Reddit
watchlist.news_note: Q2 revenue +61% and strong ad growth, but declining external-search referrals hurt visibility; valuation demanding.

watchlist.name: EQT Corporation
watchlist.news_note: Higher 2026 production guidance on lower capex, but Q2 revenue fell ~29% YoY on soft nat-gas pricing and missed consensus.

watchlist.name: Ciena
watchlist.news_note: AI optical demand, record backlog, FY2027 growth guided 30%+; but supply constraints may persist into 2028 and ~half of revenue is hyperscalers.

watchlist.name: Vertiv
watchlist.news_note: Revenue +24.1% with EPS beat, FY2026 guidance maintained; AI data-center demand intact.

watchlist.name: CF Industries
watchlist.news_note: H1 earnings +92% on tight nitrogen supply, but quarterly miss; analysts expect FY2027 earnings to fall as cycle normalizes.

watchlist.name: DoorDash
watchlist.news_note: Q2 revenue +35.6% and strong FCF, but GAAP net income fell 30%; heavy stock comp and a $700-800M payment-timing hit cloud cash quality.

watchlist.name: Expedia Group
watchlist.news_note: Revenue +14%, EPS/EBITDA beats, guidance raised on strong B2B growth.

watchlist.name: Southwest Airlines
watchlist.news_note: Record revenue and big Q2 EPS beat, but 2026 EPS guidance cut on jet-fuel surge; capacity plans reduced.

watchlist.name: Comfort Systems USA
watchlist.news_note: Data-center construction drove 51% same-store revenue growth; record $8.1B backlog; mid-to-high-30% 2026 same-store growth guide.

watchlist.name: Marvell Technology
watchlist.news_note: Data-center revenue +46%, above-consensus guide, major Google custom-chip deal; but shares nearly tripled this year — expectations lofty.

watchlist.name: Monolithic Power Systems
watchlist.news_note: Q2 revenue +47.6% with EPS beat, above-consensus Q3 guide on AI-server power demand.

watchlist.name: Analog Devices
watchlist.news_note: Revenue +39.2% with beats, strong margins, low debt; no red flag found.

watchlist.name: Casey's
watchlist.news_note: Revenue +24.3%, guidance held on Fikes integration and store expansion; but inside same-store sales missed and fuel gallons declined.

watchlist.name: Martin Marietta Materials
watchlist.news_note: Revenue +21% beat and raised FY revenue guide; but EPS fell $5.43 to $5.00 and acquisitions drive part of the growth.

near_miss.name: Expand Energy
near_miss.news_note: 216% TTM revenue growth is a merger artifact (Oct 2024 Chesapeake/Southwestern); actual Q2 revenue fell 10.6% YoY.

near_miss.name: Teradyne
near_miss.news_note: Revenue +103.9% with EPS beat and new AI test products — but shares up ~194% YoY, so it fails the "hasn't shot up yet" premise.

near_miss.name: Cincinnati Financial
near_miss.news_note: Q2 net income inflated by $882M after-tax equity-securities gain; non-GAAP operating income fell $311M to $224M, combined ratio worsened to 100.8%.

near_miss.name: McCormick & Company
near_miss.news_note: Growth inflated by $1.2B McCormick de Mexico acquisition; organic sales only 1-3%, tariffs pressuring 2026 EPS.
